run_mean_pool_features: run the script to mean pool wav2vec representations by compressing uniform splits of feature data
run_mean_pool_with_subsample: run mean pooling on audio features with a custom subsample rate to reduce sequence length
run_mean_pool_remove_extra: run mean pooling on features using remove-extra mode to trim states that cannot be evenly pooled
run_mean_pool_with_padding: run mean pooling on features using padding mode to handle states that cannot be evenly divided
review_mean_pool_main: review the main function that loads numpy features, mean pools them on GPU, and saves results
